messages:
maria: FYI ran hybrid AWQ-int8 on r4-large for the new gpt-small-v2 candidate. Initial evals show TableX extraction accuracy down ~7% compared to fp32 baseline.
jonathan: oof, which split? schema-preserving or freeform?
maria: schema-preserving. precision/recall went 0.88 -> 0.81 on numeric cols. EM 0.92 -> 0.85.
lee: did you run with kv-cache enabled? last time AWQ had boundary issues when kv chunking changed.
maria: yes kv-cache on. batch 16, seq 1024. Tried default prefetch.
jonathan: can you paste the eval command + image/commit?
maria: `python eval/run_eval.py --model gpt-small-v2-awq-int8 --dataset tablex --split dev --bs 16 --seq 1024` image: `redwood/serve:2027-03-08-awq` commit: `f3a2b9d`
dev-bot: Canary deploy started for gpt-small-v2-awq-int8 on pool-alpha (3 nodes)
lee: also saw CSV cell merge in a few outputs (commas dropped) — looks like tokenizer/bytepair mismatch after quant.
tara: did the FP8 run show the same? the FP8 candidate from last week was much closer to baseline.
maria: FP8 run: precision 0.91 recall 0.90 — so regression seems AWQ-int8 specific.
jonathan: hypothesis: quant noise -> softmax scale shift -> numeric token mapping flips. Possibly scale/zero-point error during fp32->int8 dequant.
lee: can we collect token-level probs for failing examples? `python infra/log_tool.py --fetch token_probs --trace 4234` should help.
maria: uploaded one failing example to /tmp/failing_table_example.json and linked eval: https://console.redwood.ai/evals/4234
tara: should we assign to quant oncall? @jonathan @lee
jonathan: I'll bisect kernels tomorrow. Plan: disable per-token scaling in AWQ, re-run eval diff, then jump kernel by kernel.
maria: good. I'll add failing set to canary gating and set rollout hold if regression >5%.
dev-bot: Canary health report: pool-alpha 3/3 nodes, avg latency +4ms, error-rate +0.2%
lee: small note for bisect: check sparse-matmul fallback path and any kernel touching block-sparsity / alignment — saw similar token shuffles in vendor lib before.
maria: noted. adding steps to the runbook: collect token probs, run with kv-cache off, run with `--disable-per-token-scale`, capture model logits and tokenizer mapping. Will post results here when done.
jonathan: also try a quick run with seq 256 to see if it's length/boundary dependent.
maria: will run both. thanks.
